basic_info.description: Welcome to this beautifully updated corner unit in a quaint 4-unit building, ideally located just one block from scenic Mountain Lake Park in San Francisco's highly sought-after Inner Richmond neighborhood.  This light-filled 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath home seamlessly blends classic San Francisco charm with modern updates. Enjoy timeless details like crown molding, high ceilings, a gas fireplace, and gorgeous refinished hardwood floors throughout. The spacious layout includes a bright living room, an elegant formal dining area, in-unit laundry, and a thoughtfully refreshed kitchen with new appliances, countertops, and stylish lighting.  Additional features include fresh interior paint, generous closet space, a large private storage unit, and a rare private garage. The shared backyard offers a serene outdoor retreat, perfect for relaxing or entertaining.  With low HOA dues, easy access to shops, restaurants, public transit, and some of the city's best green spaces, this home is the perfect balance of comfort, convenience, and classic San Francisco character.  Don't miss this rare opportunity to own in one of the city's most desirable neighborhoods!
